document.title: Document
document.description: The text to summarize. It is redacted by the intake pipeline before the agent ever sees it, so the container works on placeholders where the original carried identity.

audience.title: Who is reading
audience.description: Pitches the brief. The agent names a step, never a model — which model answers is the admin's configuration for that step.

focus.title: Focus on (optional)
focus.description: A subject to keep in view while extracting, e.g. "the customer impact".
